svg.aria-label: social-media: A post and its cover, every claim checked. Two sub-skills: blog-post and blog-cover. Steps: Brief, prompt translated, facts listed; Hooks, five titles, six typed hooks; Draft, Thai with kien-thai, or English; Review, humanizer, then bench_post.py; Cover, banner-design cover, benched. Output: a post that passes its case and a cover that reads at 400px.
